review_description: Helped through each process and were very patient with me. And once everything was set in place ready to go, it all happened very quickly and the communication was amazing. making sure (after install) everything was going well.Cannot recommend these guys highly enough....... Awesome!!

Great customer service,The team at solar wholesalers were informative and happy to guide me through the process of installing my solar system from start to finish.Would recommend highly to anyone thinking of getting solar installed.Admin were happy to answer questions, and the installers were tidy and prompt.
From quotation to installation & final connection to grid, all aspects were undertaken with informed advice, great communication & total efficiency. Highly recommended Solar supply company.

We were extremely pleased with all aspects of our solar installation. All staff were friendly & efficient. The installers completely cleaned up after their work. We received follow up phone calls from the office to ensure we were happy with it.The 2 installers would be the most polite young men we have encountered.

Quoting excellent, Installation a day early which was great, excellent team work with the 4 installers all very polite helpful in every way answered any questions. Very helpful with grid connection as well, even warned us what may happen with AGL which did happen they will not climb on any roof., which was a flat carport roof had to take of 2 sheets OFF so he could get his ladder and self through. OH&S has just become ridiculous.. but it was okay for my husband to get up & he is in his seventies.  we would recommend solar wholesalers to any one & they seem to travel anywhere.  we used them 10 years ago & they are still great & so helpful. keep up the great work

The overall experience and service was excellent from our initial phone contact with the sales consultant to the final installation.  Solar Wholealers was recommended by friends who had a system installed in 2019 and were not disappointed.We requested a face to face consultation at our home before signing the contract which the Consultant was more than happy to do.The installers went about their business in a very timely and very polite manner.  Arriving when they said they would and cleaning up after themselves.  A credit to their mothers!On completion of the  installation the technician talked us through the  operations of the system and happy to answer any questions we had offering to come out once we were connected to the grid which was organised by their customer service department.
